payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_spec_citations.py::test_a_citation_no_single_construct_it_names_holds_is_refused_at_its_own_commit stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/spec_citations.py. The claim was 'Called without `movable`, `citation_count_and_defects` refuses a citation that passes every check it made before, when the names of its clause open a construct at the commit and no single name holds it. A name holds it by the rule `citations_held_at` applies. The refusal reads `<path>:<range>: no single construct it names holds it (they sit at <path>:<spans>)`, with every span those names open. It sits in text order among the other defects. A citation `_construct_defect` refuses keeps that one defect alone. `citation_defects`, and `citation_count_and_defects` given `movable=False`, report what each reported before. The witness drives four refused shapes. A clause names one construct and a second name the lines quote, which opens none. A clause names a construct whose name the lines quote outside it. One name opens two constructs. One range holds two disjoint constructs. The second shape is driven through a bare citation as well. Four citations stay unflagged. One single construct holds the first, and the inner of two nested ones holds the second. The third names no construct, and the fourth spans its whole construct. A construct defect is reported once, in its old words.'. Under the edit the whole `tests` gate failed tests/test_spec_citations.py::test_a_use_site_citation_is_left_while_its_definition_citation_is_rewritten, and the criterion's witness did not fail.
